b:
Preschool.. the place where, before going to school, you learn what you need to learn at school. There certainly are Abhimanyus who learned in the womb what they were supposed to learn at preschool

I am no Abhimanyu

The preschool doors welcomed me with a roar. It was a Catholic preschool. I learned through the mercy of Lord Jesus. Those days of running to the toilet at the sound of the headmistress's break bell, lining up, staring blankly because I couldn't do my zip up properly, will never come again

I long to lift that brass bell.. longing once more in life for breaks without fears about the next day

They say that when nursery ended I would run out and, without waiting for anyone, flag down an auto on the road and climb in.... Today, when I refuse to take any auto except Uber, this piece of evidence often comes up in Amma's weary grumbling

That preschool boy's world was full of good people

It thought only good things

How did today's me rise out of the boy who believed everything was good?

He could have stayed that way

in that world of beauty

with his friends

an age when everyone you met gave you friendship

Of those who studied with me there, only one girl stays in my memory.. I have forgotten what she looked like. Though I remember her name, I won't bring it up; it is for her and me.. I have memories of travelling with her in the same van… memories of dressing up and dancing and singing at a show, of running with a lemon on a spoon, still sit green somewhere in my heart

Beyond that there is not much stored in the archive of memory.. She was the friend I spent time with every day at nursery. That is enough for friendship.

That little boy didn't know that his friendship with her would vanish tomorrow like a mirage… If he had known, he would never have passed through the last chapters of nursery.

Once he passed through them, he disappeared
note: In the Mahabharata, Abhimanyu learned how to break into the chakravyuha battle formation while still in his mother's womb.
